title: Eliminating Thermal Bridges in Insulated Concrete Assemblies
subtitle: Design Strategies for High Performance Envelopes
blurb: Thermal bridging remains a key obstacle to true efficiency in concrete envelopes. This presentation explores strategies to maintain continuous insulation in precast and cast-in-place systems, including advanced connectors, detailing methods aligned with modern energy codes, and guidance for evaluating performance/cost/constructability trade-offs.
